en: Vintage black‑and‑white picture postcard with an Art Nouveau frame. The front shows a view of a city square with a tram, pedestrians, and buildings, with a hilltop castle in the background. The image is captioned "Marijin trg." and the city name "Ljubljana" is printed decoratively. The reverse has handwritten message and address, a green Austro‑Hungarian stamp, and a circular postmark reading "LJUBLJANA," with the printed word "Dopisnica."
